ls (list) shows the files and folders where you're standing.
The ones ending in / are folders.
ls + pwd ikilisi, yabancı bir sistemde y: ls plus pwd is the fastest way to orient yourself on an unfamiliar system.

now you also see permissions, owner and size.

cd (change directory) moves you between folders.
